summary: Phase 2.5 (code-quality/hardening) regression pass. Backend /api/ and /api/health return exact same JSON shape as Phase 2 (service=aura-guard-compliance-auditor, status=ok / status=healthy + ISO timestamp). CORS still permissive. Frontend Dashboard renders KPIs (10/5/3/2), integrity card is emerald (All checks passed) via new integrityTone/integrityDetail helpers. Conformance page has exactly 10 rows with correct meta (binding_matrix_version=1.3, protocol_version=unspecified, bundle_version=1, verifier=aura-guard-conformance-core/0.3.0), Overall PASS. Distribution: 9 PASS + 1 NOT_APPLICABLE (impl:cross-implementation NOT_APPLICABLE as required; impl:attestation-signature PASS via WebCrypto Ed25519). Tamper Demo: applying a distinct new value on DEC-0001 flips header badge to FAIL, shows TAMPERED, 'Integrity failure detected' message, and reset restores PASS. Audit page renders 10 audit-row-* entries. Report page shows Compliance Audit Report title, decision ledger, verification, and attestation section text mentioning Ed25519 and INV-FLT-01. No JS console errors on any page.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx calls integrityTone(integrityOk) three times inline in JSX (lines 155/167/168) — memoize once per render to avoid redundant object allocations (cosmetic, not a bug).

Tamper Demo pre-fills 'New value' with the current stored value, so a naive click of Apply tamper with the default input produces a TAMPERED badge but no actual hash drift (integrity stays PASS). Not a regression from Phase 2.5, but worth flagging: consider disabling Apply when new value === current, or auto-mutating the pre-fill so demo works on first click without editing.

backend/server.py still constructs an AsyncIOMotorClient at import time even though the demo is in-memory; consider removing to shrink cold start / attack surface (behavior-preserving deferred cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2.5 refactor verified behavior-preserving. Conformance shows 9 PASS + 1 NOT_APPLICABLE (spec allowed 8+2 or 9+1). If future runs see attestation drop to NOT_APPLICABLE it's still spec-compliant. When testing Tamper Demo programmatically, always overwrite the 'New value' input with a distinct string; the pre-filled value equals the stored value so a raw click will not actually mutate anything.
